statement_en: Article 26(1) of the Universal Declaration of Human Rights recognizes a right to education.
Article 26(1) says elementary and fundamental education should be free, and elementary education compulsory.
Article 26(2) directs education toward human development and respect for rights and fundamental freedoms.
Article 26(3) recognizes a prior parental right to choose the kind of education provided to their children.
Article 13(1) of the ICESCR recognizes the right of everyone to education.
Article 13(2)(a) of the ICESCR provides for compulsory primary education available free to all.
Article 13(2)(b) of the ICESCR envisages making secondary education generally available and accessible, including through the progressive introduction of free education.
qualification: Do not mistakenly describe all levels as immediately free.

statement_en: Article 2(2) of the ICESCR requires States parties to guarantee covenant rights without discrimination on listed grounds.
qualification: Distinct from operational evidence that a State complied.

statement_en: Article 28(1) of the Convention on the Rights of the Child recognizes the right of the child to education.
Article 28(1)(a) of the Convention on the Rights of the Child calls for compulsory primary education available free to all.
Article 28(1)(e) calls for measures to encourage regular school attendance and reduce dropout.
UNESCO’s Convention against Discrimination in Education was adopted in Paris on 14 December 1960.
UNESCO’s Convention against Discrimination in Education entered into force on 22 May 1962.
Article 1 of the UNESCO Convention describes discrimination in education in terms of distinctions or exclusions impairing equality of treatment.
qualification: Do not substitute the convention definition for all domestic legal systems.

statement_en: UNESCO summarizes State obligations concerning education as duties to respect, protect and fulfil the right.
UNESCO presents availability, accessibility, acceptability and adaptability as four essential features of the right to education.
UNESCO UIS lists SDG indicator 4.1.1 on minimum reading and mathematics proficiency and indicator 4.1.2 on educational completion rates.
UNESCO UIS lists indicator 4.1.4 on out-of-school rates and indicator 4.1.7 on legally guaranteed years of free and compulsory education.
UNESCO UIS lists indicator 4.5.1 on parity indices and indicator 4.5.4 on education expenditure per student by level and funding source.
